title: Multi-output classification with cross-talk architecture for compound motor fault diagnosis under partially labeled domain adaptation
core_idea: Develop a multi-output classification framework for domain adaptation in partially labeled target datasets for compound motor fault diagnosis, explore single-task and multi-task architectures (including shared-trunk and cross-talk designs), and propose a novel cross-talk module called residual neural dimension reductor (RNDR) together with frequency-layer normalization to enable selective information sharing across diagnostic tasks and improve adaptation on motor vibration data.
tldr: Proposes an MOC formulation and a cross-talk architecture (RNDR) with frequency-layer normalization to handle compound fault diagnosis under partially labeled domain adaptation, and investigates architecture variants on motor vibration domain-shift scenarios.
